description: The line plot illustrates the overall ROUGE-G score across different models as a function of the number of training examples, with the x-axis representing the number of training examples on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64, and the y-axis showing the overall ROUGE-G score on a linear scale from 11.0 to 19.0. The legend identifies six models: PELMS (5%), Pegasus-X, Pegasus-X (5%), Primera, Primera (5%), and Centrum (5%). The green solid line with circular markers, labeled PELMS (5%), starts at a ROUGE-G score of approximately 16.5 at 0 training examples and increases to about 18.5 at 64 training examples, showing a consistent upward trend. The green dashed line with circular markers, labeled Pegasus-X, begins at a ROUGE-G score of approximately 16.8 at 0 training examples and rises to about 18.7 at 64 training examples, also showing a steady increase. The red solid line with square markers, labeled Primera, starts at a ROUGE-G score of approximately 15.2 at 0 training examples and increases to about 17.8 at 64 training examples, indicating a consistent upward trend. The red dashed line with square markers, labeled Primera (5%), begins at a ROUGE-G score of approximately 14.8 at 0 training examples and rises to about 15.8 at 64 training examples, showing a gradual increase. The yellow dashed line with diamond markers, labeled Centrum (5%), starts at a ROUGE-G score of approximately 15.0 at 0 training examples and increases to about 15.8 at 64 training examples, displaying a slight upward trend. The blue dashed line with triangular markers, labeled Pegasus-X (5%), begins at a ROUGE-G score of approximately 13.5 at 0 training examples, drops to about 11.5 at 16 training examples, and then rises to about 14.0 at 64 training examples, showing a U-shaped trend.
